description: What serving AI tokens on each GPU costs and earns at today's prices: the break-even throughput (tokens per second one GPU must sell at a model's or company's posted price to cover its rental) and, given a throughput, the GPU's cost per 1M tokens, revenue per GPU-hour and gross margin.

gpu.description: One GPU; omit for all listed.

model.description: A model's name or page id (its posted prices); omit to use each company's index.

throughput_tokens_per_second.description: Tokens per second one GPU generates (input and output, 3 to 1).

name: get_workload_cost

breakeven_tokens_per_second.description: Tokens per second one GPU must sell at the blended price to cover its rental

cost_per_1m_tokens.description: The GPU's rental cost per 1M tokens at the given throughput

title: Inference economics per GPU
